title: DHCP snooping ticket: trust is on the wrong port
summary: Repair the trusted-path mistake while preserving VLAN 20 protection.
brief: Clients in VLAN 20 cannot obtain valid DHCP leases after a source-validation rollout. DHCP snooping is enabled, but trust is configured on Ethernet1, an endpoint-facing port. Inspect local snooping and running configuration evidence, remove the unsafe trust, and trust Ethernet48 as the infrastructure-facing DHCP path. This local-only ticket does not simulate DHCP offers, binding tables, or client traffic; it grades the configuration and evidence workflow.
objectives: Identify the incorrectly trusted endpoint port
hints: Use the DHCP snooping show command before changing configuration.
Only the legitimate server-facing path should be trusted.
Preserve DHCP snooping and VLAN 20 while moving trust.

checks.label: DHCP snooping remains enabled for VLAN 20
Ethernet48 is trusted as the infrastructure path
